title: 1919 Prairie: the curved front bay now rises to the roof
items: The curved bay on the front of Marshall Field Jr.'s house at 1919 Prairie Avenue now rises the full height of the wall, and the main roof's eave and moulding sweep round it, as the house's 1913 and 1919 pictures show. Before, it stopped short under the eave with a low cap of its own.
Its upper windows now line up with the rest of the upper floor. Still to come: the rounded north corner, then the stepped gables and two-storey bays along the north side.
